run_discover_active_areas: run the script to discover active areas on an object surface most frequently touched by a specific finger part
run_show_active_areas: run the script with --show to visualize active areas on a 3D mesh using Open3D
run_discover_thumb_tip_use: run the script with finger_idx 0 and part_idx 3 to find thumb tip active areas for use intent
run_discover_little_finger_handoff: run the script with finger_idx 4 to find little finger active areas for handoff intent
run_discover_custom_participants: run the script with --p_nums to discover active areas for a custom range of participant numbers
